title: NarrativeTrace Chapter
description: One service's complete contribution to a trace. Assembled by the library from all entries, emitted on request completion or chapter close. Contains Layer 1+2 fields plus chapter-specific Layer 3 fields. The nt.chapterTree field embeds the full nested trace tree (only sent to NarrativeTrace backend, omitted for third-party platforms).

level.description: Log level. info for success, warn/error for failures.

message.description: Human-readable summary. e.g., 'Chapter complete: OrderService.createOrder [251ms] success'.

nt.chapterId.description: Unique chapter identifier. Generated by the library.

nt.storyId.description: Story this chapter belongs to. Typically derived from trace_id.

nt.title.description: Chapter title derived from the root method call. e.g., 'OrderService.createOrder'.

nt.startTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the first entry in this chapter.

nt.endTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last exit in this chapter.

nt.totalDurationMs.description: Wall-clock duration from first entry to last exit.

nt.entryCount.description: Total number of entries in this chapter.

nt.completionStatus.description: Whether all async branches completed within the assembly window.

nt.timedOutSpans.description: Span IDs of entries that did not receive a matching exit within the assembly window.

nt.chapterTree.description: Serialized JSON of the full nested trace tree for this chapter. Only sent to NarrativeTrace backend (fullSchema: true). Omitted when shipping to third-party platforms (fullSchema: false). Validated by chapter-tree.schema.json.

nt.schemaVersion.description: Global canonical schema version, shared with entry.schema.json (stamped from CanonicalEntry.SCHEMA_VERSION; decision 2026-08-18). Bumped in lockstep with the entry schema even when the chapter envelope shape is unchanged.
